name: 小鼠獭
evolution: 小鼠獭 → 燕尾獭 Lv.30 → 卷胡巨獭 Lv.48
description: 总是在啃着什么，包括自己的手和尾巴。扒开小鼠獭的嘴巴仔细观察也找不到牙，牙床嫩嫩的，还没有牙的痕迹。
descriptionEn: It is always gnawing on something, including its own hands and tail. Even if you pry open its mouth and look closely, no teeth can be found; its gums are tender, with no trace of teeth yet.

skills.name: 落星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。

skills.descriptionEn: The enemy's skills other than the one used this turn have their energy cost +3, lasting 3 turns.
